material_basis: Declared cohesionless SCM demonstration family; not measured GRC-3 stiffness or local lunar regolith. Pressure/sinkage parameters are not identifiable from these traction-only observations and are fixed rather than fitted.
split_rule: Nominal slip groups 0/0.2/0.4/0.6/0.8 train; 0.05/0.1/0.3/0.5/0.7 hold out. All repeats of a slip group stay together. Source coordinates are not rounded or changed during execution.
selection: Minimize training RMS traction discrepancy; freeze selected candidate and its hash before evaluating any holdout. Holdout outcomes must not select or tune candidates.
target_scope: Predeclared development gates, not experimental uncertainty or an operational accuracy bound.
limitations: Held-out plot points from one published Earth experiment are not a new independent experiment or lunar validation.
The grousered wheel and high slip range stress the applicability of this semi-empirical model; failed gates remain failures.
No fitted parameter is presented as uniquely identified soil physics.
No flight-rover, full-rover, battery, thermal, steering, variable load or measured-terrain prediction is validated by this family.
No lunar gravity prediction is accepted from Earth calibration alone.
